description: This file defines a React functional component called 'MenuLayout' that composes a layout with a configurable sidebar, drag-to-resize functionality, and a panel component. It imports constants, hooks, utility functions, and types, and manages internal state for panel visibility and external properties. The component dynamically adjusts sidebar width via drag events and renders child components with relevant props.

methods.name: MenuHood
methods.description: A nested functional component within MenuLayout that handles the rendering of the sidebar, dragger, and panel, managing sidebar width state and handling drag events for resizing.
